text:
mira_csm: Heads up — Meridian Claims wants to onboard a customer-supplied ASR model for claims intake. Requirements: PHI, private VPC, BYOK/HSM, streaming websocket, and p95 latency target <=280ms. They mentioned renewal sensitivity; if delayed, renewal conversation may be delayed.

diego_se: Understood. Do we have model artifact details? framework, size, opset?

mira_csm: They shared a link: 'meridian-asr-2026.onnx' (approx 14GB) + sample transcripts. They explicitly require partial transcripts for agent assist.

rhea_sg: Security checklist: BAA, KMS plan for BYOK, HSM keywrap, restricted egress, and audit log retention 7 years. Also ask whether tokenization/redaction is server-side or client-side.

sam_eval: I'll run a focused eval. Proposed metrics: WER on claims corpus, p95 streaming latency, real-time factor, and insertion/hallucination rate. Will baseline against our hosted-asr.

diego_se: Quick notes: 14GB may need model parallelism or bigger GPU instance; check ONNX opset compatibility. For routing, plan fallback to hosted-asr for requests exceeding latency SLO. Also add cost cap alarms.

mira_csm: Customer asked for pilot by 2026-07-01. Can we deliver?

diego_se: Tight but possible if perf tuning gets p95 under 280ms. Need infra sizing decision by 6/20 and perf run by 6/24.

onboard-bot: ticket CS-5088 created: "Meridian ASR private onboarding" assigned to diego_se.

sam_eval: Smoke run results: WER 6.8% on claims set, p95 latency 340ms on default runtime, RTF 0.36. I'll try kernel swap and 8-bit quant and re-run, expect next update in ~4 hours.

rhea_sg: Legal loop: BAA requested, adding contract owner to ticket. Also need customer confirmation on server-side redaction option.

diego_se: I'll draft canary plan and infra ticket for dedicated-large nodes. If tuning can't meet 280ms, propose staged rollout: 20% private, 80% fallback hosted; increase as we improve.

mira_csm: Action items: diego -> infra + canary runbook; rhea -> security gating + BAA; sam -> tuned eval + recommend acceptance thresholds; i'll message renewal owner. Keep thread focused. :thumbsup:
